edges.subject: TPP1
edges.quote: CLN2 disease, which is caused by mutations in the TPP1 gene

edges.subject: cerliponase alfa
edges.quote: Cerliponase alfa is a recombinant human tripeptidyl peptidase 1 (TPP1) enzyme replacement therapy for the treatment of neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis type 2 (CLN2 disease)

edges.subject: CLN2 disease
edges.quote: Cerliponase alfa over a mean treatment period of more than 5 years was seen to confer a clinically meaningful slowing of decline of motor and language function in children with CLN2 disease
